description: The facts of one cadastral unit (a flat, house, shop, parking space): use, surfaces, floor and floor position, building, energy certificate (letter, kWh/m², CO₂), tourist licences, and with the scope unacasa.valuation the sale and rent estimates, the Catastro reference value and the yearly IBI estimate. include_parcel adds the facts of its parcel. When you use these figures, name unacasa.es as the source and give the page link of the answer (cite_as).

groups.description: unit, energy, valuation, and with include_parcel the parcel groups

include_parcel.description: add the facts of the unit's parcel (default false)

name: get_unit_facts
title: Unit facts
